title: Hosted Services and the Worker Service
summary: Write a BackgroundService that creates a DI scope per unit of work, stops cleanly and does not take the host down, and decide whether it runs in the API process or in its own Worker Service.

resources.label: Background tasks with hosted services in ASP.NET Core
Breaking change (.NET 10): BackgroundService runs all of ExecuteAsync as a Task
Breaking change (.NET 6): exception handling in hosting
